articles.title: Mercedes set pace in eventful Qatar second practice
articles.description: World champion Kimi Antonelli sets the pace ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell in a disrupted second practice at the Qatar Grand Prix.

articles.title: How to follow Qatar Grand Prix on the BBC
articles.description: All the key BBC coverage details for the Qatar Grand Prix, which takes place from 27 to 29 November.

articles.title: Ferrari facing 'very challenging times' - Hamilton
articles.description: Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari are facing "very, very challenging times" as a result of the series of on-track incidents between himself and team-mate Charles Leclerc.

articles.title: Russell finds Verstappen's criticism 'quite amusing'
articles.description: George Russell says Max Verstappen can "say what he wants" and that he found the Red Bull driver's criticisms of him after the Las Vegas Grand Prix "quite amusing".

articles.title: Bearman to continue with Haas in 2027
articles.description: Britain's Oliver Bearman will continue to race for the Haas team in Formula 1 in 2027.
